This proposal is for $5,000 USD to fund the completion of a new R package, {geoarrowrs}.

https://github.com/JosiahParry/sfconversions
https://github.com/JosiahParry/rsgeo
https://github.com/extendr/arrow-extendr
https://github.com/JosiahParry/geoarrowrs/

The `{geoarrow}` R package provides only an R-native representation of geoarrow and integrates with the {arrow} R package

`{geoarrowrs}` provides bindings to the geoarrow-rust library

R bindings to the geoarrow-rust library: https://geoarrow.org/geoarrow-rs/

with custom bindings to the geo rust crate for high performace computation
https://github.com/georust/geo

Milestones:

- CRAN submissions and release
